chapters.title: Chapter 364 Ma Huiying’s Request for Help
paragraphs: Tian Yong begged and pleaded, but to no avail. No one dared to take the job; it was a fate that would have put anyone in danger.
Desperate, Tian Yong brought a large sum of cash to the home of Principal Du Sheng, hoping to get him help.

Unfortunately, Du Sheng himself was in dire straits. The previous incident could no longer be contained; everyone had embezzled project funds. The investigation team was now fully investigating the poisoning incident and had pledged to dig deeper. His old boss had stopped answering his calls. What did this mean? It meant he had been abandoned, beyond hope.
Zhao An also saw Du Sheng's call but chose not to answer it. Instead, he made several calls, determined to publicize this school cafeteria incident.

Last night's evening news had already reported on the incident. Even the lid of a coffin couldn't contain it; someone would definitely be imprisoned. Without someone in custody, we couldn't give up so easily. This time, someone had to take charge. Someone had to take responsibility, and it was clearly the cafeteria owner.

Lin Cui, who had taken a taxi to a coffee shop, sat in a window seat on the second floor, stirring her coffee with one hand and resting her chin on the other. She appeared incredibly relaxed, feeling no pressure at all. The position of Deputy Dean of Students was easy, and it wasn't impossible for her to advance further, she just hadn't considered it.
Ma Huiying walked upstairs with a hint of fatigue. Seeing the incredibly elegant Lin Cui, a flicker of envy crossed her eyes.
"Teacher Lin, my husband wants to divorce me. Woohoo."

Lin Cui ordered a cup of coffee for him and said with a smile, "Sit down. It's no big deal. A woman can live comfortably without a man. But your husband has had problems with the cafeteria, and they're now pursuing legal action. What are you going to do? Don't get implicated."

"Woohoo! How am I going to live without Xiaohan?" Ma Huiying said in agony, covering her face. She felt a little overwhelmed. Before, because her husband owned the cafeteria, she was safe from predators. But now, things were different. She knew some students had ulterior motives.

Lin Cui's expression was calm. She offered no persuasion, but instead spoke with a hint of intrigue, "You could actually choose to have another child. You're still young, and some things can't be forced. Besides, your son is old enough, and the court would have let him choose for himself. He chose your husband, didn't he? Since he doesn't want you anymore, you should reflect on yourself and perhaps rethink your path. You're still young, in your early thirties, and you have the best years of your life."

Ma Huiying looked up at Lin Cui with disbelief, as if she couldn't believe her close friend would say such a thing. Their relationship had been quite good recently; building friendships between women wasn't difficult. "You, why do you say that?"

"Because I've been through it all, I understand how you feel. When I divorced, I was also incredibly lost. My son is also very rebellious. Now, he barely speaks to me except for asking me for money. A woman needs to find someone to rely on, not just for herself, but also for her future. Have you considered being helpless in her old age?" Lin Cui spoke with deep emotion. It was because of her understanding that every word resonated deeply with her.
Ma Huiying nodded, feeling a sense of empathy. This was why she chose to approach Lin Cui instead of her relatives. "Teacher Lin, what do you think I should do?"
"You and your husband are divorced, right?" Lin Cui asked.
It was a little embarrassing to talk about this; divorce isn't a glorious thing, after all. Ma Huiying nodded and said, "Yes, we're divorced."
"Since you're divorced, you should know that many people will be watching you. You're still very attractive!" Lin Cui suddenly smiled, winking playfully, a little nervously.

Ma Huiying blushed. She knew Lin Cui was talking about her butt. Her large butt was truly a beautiful sight, and being thrust into from behind would surely be incredibly pleasurable. It was natural for someone to be obsessed with her, driven by lust. "Then, what should I do?"

"Nothing. Just find a man who can protect you. If you have any problems in the future, tell me and I'll help you if I can. The cafeteria situation is none of your business, so don't worry too much about it. If you have any ideas, you can tell me." Lin Cui was simply trying to enlighten her. She hadn't chosen to be a pimp; the most effective approach was to be completely transparent.
"Sister Lin, do you think I still have a chance to win Xiaohan over? I can't let him go!" Ma Huiying pleaded again. As a mother, she wouldn't give up her child so easily.

Lin Cui shook her head. "No, the court has already ruled. Well, I think you're feeling much better now. Go out more often. If any students harass you, you can tell me. I can only help you temporarily, not forever. And I can't intervene with some students from powerful backgrounds."

Ma Huiying blushed. Isn't this just unspoken rules? Unspoken rules exist everywhere. Some married people are fine, but those who haven't been married or are divorced need to be more cautious. "I, I understand. Thank you."
"You're welcome. Let's talk later." Lin Cui said, then stood up and walked away, gracefully swaying her hips in her high heels.
Ma Huiying glanced at Lin Cui and sighed. Women are just miserable. There are always men who want their bodies.

Elsewhere, Zhao An appeared in a bar that was closed during the day. Tang Bing and Zhao An were the only two people in the bar at the moment. Tang Bing picked up his beer and said, "Thanks, Young Master An, for your guidance. Damn, those bastards, I gave them so much, and this is how they repay me, selling me out like traitors. Fuck you!"
"I didn't give you any guidance. Don't blame me." Zhao An took the bottle and drank it straight away. He definitely wouldn't admit to such a thing.

"Haha, I said the wrong thing. I'll punish myself with three glasses of wine." Tang Bing picked up the wine and drank three glasses. Then he burped and said, "I'm listening to Young Master An and planning to withdraw from the succession race. I'll cultivate my character, build up my strength, and choose again next time. Anyway, the old man isn't dying anytime soon, so there's no rush."

chapters.title: Chapter 365 The Mysterious Woman
paragraphs: "It only happens every two years anyway. If you're not convinced, then just hold another election in two years. If you don't have the strength, no one will accept your appointment. But who becomes the head of the family is none of my business. You Tangs have nothing to do with me." Zhao An lit a cigarette, his expression somewhat cold and indifferent, for it truly had nothing to do with him.

"My sister has a Master's degree in energy technology. She often proposes proposals. We initially tried investing, but it didn't work. Three hundred million or five hundred million didn't work, so we gave up. She's smart and beautiful. If you could marry her, all crises would be resolved. Our Tang family still has prestige. Even those in the upper echelons of society can't easily change it. We already have the strength to move into the upper echelons." Tang Bing offered a lure, a lure that would make the man's heart flutter.

Becoming the son-in-law of a powerful family? That sounds good, and the Tang Group is wealthy. Being their son-in-law is a sure win. Even if you marry into the Tang family, there are plenty of potential suitors. You can save yourself decades of hard work, so why bother?
This is a common belief, but it doesn't apply to Zhao An. He has no shortage of money or connections.
"No interest," Zhao An said, picking up his wine glass.

"Becoming the Tang family's son-in-law is something many people only dream of. I know you don't need it, but joining forces with the Tang family, you and I, will surely bring in tons of money and wealth. Your livestreaming is profitable, but it can't generate 10 billion every month!" Tang Bing tried to convince him. He needed such a powerful ally.

"I'm not interested. To me, money is just a number. No matter how much money you make, it's useless if you don't have the life to spend it. I prefer spending money to making it. Can money bring happiness? Yes, as long as you have money, you have everything. Making money without spending it is a miser. Haha! Just hold off your brother's advances first. If you survive, come talk to me later." Zhao An laughed heartily, picked up the red wine bottle, and left. Cooperation? That depends on the partner.
Tang Bing's face changed, but he remained silent. Indeed, if he wanted to avoid being hunted down by his brother, he had to find a way.

After Zhao An left, the sound of high heels tapping on the floorboards echoed down the stairs. A slender woman in a large trench coat descended. She wore delicate gold-rimmed glasses, appearing very quiet and elegant. Her face was beautiful, and her aloof aura was chilling. "He turned her down, right?"

"Just as you expected, he turned her down. Why are you so optimistic about him?" Tang Bing was puzzled. Of the three siblings, he, the eldest, always seemed a bit behind the times, but he was quite skilled at socializing and winning people over. It's just that he's been surpassed by his younger brother in recent years; otherwise, there wouldn't be so many traitors.

"The future's profitable industry will definitely be new energy. He can spend tens of billions developing residential communities just to satisfy his own lust. Someone like him would definitely be willing to invest in the energy industry." The woman with the glasses took out a cigarette and lit it, her puffing technique expert, looking like a woman with a story to tell.

"The energy industry is too expensive, and I haven't seen anyone figure it out." Tang Bing knew it was profitable, but coal's profit margins were so low that it was mostly used for thermal power generation. And coal wasn't easy to sell. And natural gas and oil, well, if you don't want to get yourself into trouble, don't touch them.

After much thought, the only option was to develop new energy sources, electricity or some other renewable energy source. Especially in this era of environmental protection, the emergence of new energy sources not only brings in generous subsidies but also allows for eye-catching advertising. After all, high-tech things are always popular.

"Keep going. Tang Wu will definitely kill you. You've been suppressed for so long. You'd better clean up your mess. Then you'll be the one to die." The woman with the glasses said this before standing up and walking away with a professional, cat-like gait. She didn't look like Tang Bing's wife, but rather a relative.
Seeing the woman leave on her own, her aura truly resembled his mother.
After leaving the bar, Zhao An drove to the company. On the way, he saw an unexpected woman and called out, "Teacher Ma."

Ma Huiying, still half asleep, heard someone calling her and looked up. She saw a man's face. It looked familiar, but she couldn't place it for a moment, but she soon remembered. Zhao An's enormous cock had left a deep impression on her, and she immediately remembered him. "Classmate, what's up?"
"Come on in the car! I'll give you a ride," Zhao An waved.

Ma Huiying hesitated for a moment before walking over. Zhao An wasn't some scion of a government official, but he was a genius, a genius whose voices could often be heard even in the teachers' office.

She opened the car door, and two round, millstone-sized buttocks pressed against the seat. Ma Huiying, perceiving the man's gaze, felt a little shy. She didn't know why she had such a large buttocks. "Classmate, thank you."

"You're welcome. I heard there was an incident in the cafeteria recently. Are you divorced, teacher? You're the dream girl of many of our students," Zhao An complimented, unabashedly, though the words were cleverly uttered. "Dream girl," it felt like a compliment no matter how you looked at it.

Ma Huiying was indeed the dream girl of many students. Every day, countless male students masturbated to her large buttocks. Calling her a dream girl wasn't an exaggeration at all. Hearing her classmates' praise, Ma Huiying smiled sheepishly, "Thank you."

"You're welcome. Teacher Ma, if you have any problems in the future, you can come to me. I can still help you sort out some things. I heard that your husband and his mistress already have another son—oh no, your ex-husband, that's right. He's so energetic. Haha, you're still young, don't be so bound by this. You still have the best years of your youth and can still get married," Zhao An counseled with a smile.

It sounded familiar to Ma Huiying. It seemed like Lin Cui had said the same thing to her. Since she was kind-hearted, she couldn't say anything, so she could only nod and say, "Yes, thank you, classmate. I'll think about it."

Liu Ke, dressed in prison uniform, looked fine, apparently doing well in prison. A calm, middle-aged, overweight man sat across from him through a glass window.
"Brother Huang, any instructions?" Liu Jin hesitated as he faced the man.
The portly man before him was none other than Huang Meng, the second heir to the Huang family, who had come from afar to expand the market.

In reality, a secret unknown to everyone was that Liu Ke's wife was Huang Meng's cousin. They were somewhat related, though not particularly close, just a casual connection. They were neither distant nor close.

However, annexing a family's assets wasn't so simple, so Huang Meng resorted to his underworld tactics, gathering some of his unfamiliar relatives together for frequent drinking and feasting. These relatives were generally unimportant, lacking resources, and therefore attracted little attention.
After spending some time wooing them, Huang Meng began to introduce them to various family businesses, launching his own espionage program.
After observing them for a while, Huang Meng would provide financial support to those who showed talent and needed support.

Liu Ke was one of those supported, and in a sense, this was a form of branching out. Compared to traditional co-optation, this method was more covert and time-consuming. However, the results were quite good; at least no one would suspect that their partner of several years was actually someone else's.

"You stay in there for now, settle down, and strive for a sentence reduction. I'll help you make arrangements later. What do you think of Zhao An?" Tang Wu sat in his office, looking at the latest financial statements, his face almost smiling. He knew he would soon be able to suppress the Future Platform. "What an idiot! A commoner rising up to compete with me for a living?" Tang Wu said with disdain, leaning back in his chair. Despite his excitement, he didn't get carried away. Instead, he focused on the other party's new business: the so-called live-streaming food delivery platform, which seemed to be very profitable.
"How's that food delivery platform doing?" Tang Wu asked his assistant, Jinnang.

"Boss, that platform is already set up, and it only has local options. A lot of restaurants have already joined the online scene, all advertising, claiming delivery within 30 minutes and offering bonuses for late arrivals! I checked, and these demands are simply courting disaster."

"From the moment the merchant prepares the takeout order to the moment someone delivers it, it takes a long time. And delivery requires time, transportation, and so on. I'm not optimistic about this platform," a bespectacled man said confidently.

No matter how they analyzed it, they all agreed it wasn't profitable. First, the number of people ordering, the number of restaurants to choose from, the quality of the food, the price, and finally, the delivery time. There are so many complex issues that can't be solved with just words. This is a fusion of online and offline operations, and it's impossible to just talk your way out of it.
Tang Wu's brow furrowed. He had already considered Zhao An a competitor. Since he was a rival, he had to deal with him, defeat him, and seize his market share.
Especially in the battle for the position of family heir, he didn't want to lose. He had to be absolutely sure of his victory, even if Tang Bing had already given up.
"Keep following up. Figure out how the platform works for me. Then we'll follow suit!" Tang Wu said, then stood up and left the office, making his way to a brightly lit office in the lobby.

However, Qian Yuling, who has always been strong, would not admit that she did not understand, and still scolded her son in a cold voice.
